faqs.q: What is the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut and what does it join?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut is a pin lug coupling pair: a male NPSH shank and a female shank with a brass NPSH nut, so it joins two hose lengths. The nut is tightened with a spanner on its pin lugs. Sizes run from 1-1/2" to 6".

faqs.q: How do I read the maker part numbers for the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut?
faqs.a: The maker's codes for the complete set end in S: AL150S is the 1-1/2" set, AL200S the 2", AL300S the 3" and AL600S the 6". The AL prefix and the size digits are the same on the male (M) and female (F) halves. Sizes 1-1/2" and 2-1/2" also list an -NST variant.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut come in?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut is listed in 1-1/2", 2", 2-1/2", 3", 4" and 6", in 6 part numbers such as IH-PLS-SHANK-COUPLING-COMPLETE-SET-BRASS-NUT-150 and IH-PLS-SHANK-COUPLING-COMPLETE-SET-BRASS-NUT-600. Each size covers one male and one female half sold together as a set.

faqs.q: Should I buy the complete set or the single halves of the pin lug shank coupling?
faqs.a: Buy the complete set when you are fitting a new hose joint, because it includes the male shank and the female shank with brass nut. Buy single halves to replace a worn half or to mate with a coupling you already own. See the [aluminum shank male coupling](/p/aluminum-shank-male-coupling) and the [female coupling with brass nut](/p/aluminum-shank-female-coupling-with-brass-nut).

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut. The shanks are held on the hose by clamps, so the clamp and the hose usually limit the joint. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What are the shank and nut of the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut made from?
faqs.a: The shanks are aluminium and the nut on the female half is brass. Brass on the nut gives a hard-wearing thread against the aluminium male thread, while aluminium keeps the shanks light for hose that is moved often.

faqs.q: Which thread standard does the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut follow?
faqs.a: The pin lug nut and male end use the NPSH hose thread, listed to ASME B1.20.7. NPSH is a straight thread, so the joint seals on the washer in the female coupling and not on the thread. That is why the washer must stay in place.

faqs.q: What does the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut connect to, and which clamps does it need?
faqs.a: It connects two hose shanks to each other, and each shank is held on its hose with a clamp sized for the hose outside diameter. It does not mate with tapered NPT threads. For clamps and sleeves see the [hose clamps shelf](/c/hose-clamps-sleeves-ferrules).

faqs.q: How do I assemble and maintain the Aluminum Shank Coupling Complete Set Brass Nut?
faqs.a: Screw the brass nut onto the male NPSH thread and tighten it with a spanner on the pin lugs. Keep the washer in place and replace it when it hardens, because the joint seals on it. Check the hose clamps at the same time. The maker publishes no working pressure, so keep to the hose rating.

faqs.q: How does the complete set differ from the aluminum shank male coupling?
faqs.a: The complete set includes both halves, male and female with brass nut, in six sizes from 1-1/2" to 6". The [male coupling](/p/aluminum-shank-male-coupling) is the male NPSH half alone, so it needs a female half to join. Both are listed in the same six sizes.

faqs.q: What is the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut and what does it do?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut is the female half of a pin lug shank coupling: a hose shank on one end and a brass NPSH nut with pin lugs on the other. It screws onto a male NPSH shank. Sizes run from 1-1/2" to 6".

faqs.q: What do the maker's codes AL150F to AL600F mean on the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut?
faqs.a: Every code is AL, then the size digits, then F for female: AL150F is 1-1/2", AL200F is 2", AL250F is 2-1/2", AL300F is 3", AL400F is 4" and AL600F is 6". The 1-1/2" and 2-1/2" sizes also list an -NST version.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut come in?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut is listed in 1-1/2", 2", 2-1/2", 3", 4" and 6", in 6 part numbers such as IH-PLS-SHANK-FEMALE-COUPLING-WITH-BRASS-NUT-150 and IH-PLS-SHANK-FEMALE-COUPLING-WITH-BRASS-NUT-600. Match the size to the male half you are joining to.

faqs.q: Which male half does the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut mate with?
faqs.a: It mates with a male NPSH shank of the same size, such as the [aluminum shank male coupling](/p/aluminum-shank-male-coupling). The pin lug nut threads onto the male end, so the nominal size and the thread must match.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What materials is the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut made from?
faqs.a: The shank is aluminium and the nut is brass. The nut carries the pin lugs and the female NPSH thread. Material is not changed per size, so every size in the table is aluminium with a brass nut.

faqs.q: What thread does the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut use?
faqs.a: The nut has a female NPSH hose thread, listed to ASME B1.20.7. NPSH is a straight thread, so the seal is made on the washer in the female coupling and not on the thread, and the washer should be replaced when it hardens.

faqs.q: What can I connect to the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut?
faqs.a: Connect it to a male NPSH pin lug shank of the same size, and fit the other end of the shank into a hose with a clamp. It is not made for tapered NPT pipe threads. See the [shank couplings shelf](/c/shank-couplings) for nipples with other thread ends.

faqs.q: How do I replace the washer in the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut?
faqs.a: Unscrew the nut from the male half, pick out the old washer and fit a new one seated flat in the female coupling before you screw the nut back on. Replace it when it hardens, because the joint seals on the washer and not on the thread.

faqs.q: How does the Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut differ from the aluminum shank male coupling?
faqs.a: The female half has the brass NPSH nut with pin lugs, while the [male coupling](/p/aluminum-shank-male-coupling) has the male NPSH thread and no nut. They cover the same six sizes, 1-1/2" to 6", and are used as a pair.

faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Female Coupling with Brass Nut is made by the manufacturer in USA. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised distributor in the UAE and ships worldwide from Dubai.

faqs.q: What is the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Male Coupling is the male half of a pin lug shank coupling: a hose shank at one end and a male NPSH thread at the other. It takes the brass nut of a female half. Sizes run from 1-1/2" to 6".

faqs.q: How are the maker part numbers AL150M to AL600M built?
faqs.a: Each code is AL for aluminium, the size digits, then M for male: AL150M is 1-1/2", AL200M is 2", AL300M is 3", AL400M is 4" and AL600M is 6". The 1-1/2" and 2-1/2" sizes also list an -NST variant.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling come in?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Male Coupling is listed in 1-1/2", 2", 2-1/2", 3", 4" and 6", in 6 part numbers such as IH-PLS-SHANK-MALE-150 and IH-PLS-SHANK-MALE-600.

faqs.q: How do I match the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling to a female half?
faqs.a: Pick the female half of the same nominal size and the NPSH thread. The [aluminum shank female coupling with brass nut](/p/aluminum-shank-female-coupling-with-brass-nut) is the matching half, and the [complete set](/p/aluminum-shank-coupling-complete-set-brass-nut) supplies both in one order.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling. Hose clamps and the hose itself usually limit the joint. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What is the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling made from?
faqs.a: The male coupling is aluminium. It has no brass nut, because the nut belongs to the female half. Aluminium keeps the pair light, and brass on the nut gives a hard-wearing thread.

faqs.q: Which thread standard does the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling follow?
faqs.a: The male end carries the NPSH hose thread, listed to ASME B1.20.7. NPSH is a straight thread, so it does not seal on the thread: the seal is the washer in the female coupling.

faqs.q: What does the male NPSH end of the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling screw into?
faqs.a: It screws into the female brass NPSH nut of a pin lug shank, such as the [female coupling](/p/aluminum-shank-female-coupling-with-brass-nut). Do not use it with tapered NPT threads. The shank end goes into the hose and is held with a clamp.

faqs.q: How do I fit the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling to a hose?
faqs.a: Push the shank fully into the hose, fit a clamp sized for the hose outside diameter and tighten it, then screw the male end into the female nut. The maker publishes no working pressure, so keep to the hose rating.

faqs.q: How does the Aluminum Shank Male Coupling differ from the complete set?
faqs.a: The male coupling is one half only, in six sizes from 1-1/2" to 6". The [complete set with brass nut](/p/aluminum-shank-coupling-complete-set-brass-nut) supplies the male shank and the female half together, which suits a new joint.

faqs.a: The Aluminum Shank Male Coupling is made by the manufacturer in USA. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised distributor in the UAE and ships worldwide from Dubai.
